description: Move a card to a different column on the same board, or to another board. newColumnId is the label-style column ID like 'Label_1' (returned by list_columns).

newBoardId.description: Target board ID. Required for cross-board moves; auto-resolved from the card's current board when omitted.

newColumnId.description: Target column ID (label-style string, e.g. 'Label_2'). Get it from list_columns.

newPosition.description: Position in the target column (0 = top, default 0)

name: move_card
title: Move a card
